essence: Oldest twin built from devotion; guards with teasing bravado. Softens only in Fiona's hands. Loves fiercely, surrenders beautifully.
open: 5'11" places her exactly on the JUNOESQUE floor under the proposed Stature scale, with Fiona on it too. The narrowest band entry in the canon, and both twins sit on the same inch.
note:
IDENTICAL, AND THE ARCHIVE MEANS IT. 5'11", 38-24-40, D-cups, PLIANT GRAB-READY BUBBLE, 8.9" — and every one of those numbers is Fiona's too, to the decimal, because the universe affirmed them ON THE SAME NIGHT and matched them rather than approximating twice. Same face, same eyes, same brat, SAME VOICE, which is the part that unsettles people who did not grow up with it.

THE ONLY TELL IS THE HAIR. IZZY IS COPPER RED WITH SNOW WHITE STREAKS; Fiona is the inverse. Both shoulder-length with the sides cut to the jaw. That is the entire difference between two human beings and they are aware of it and they use it.

OLDEST BY BIRTH, WHICH GOT HER DIBS, and Fiona let her have it — then one topped one day and the other the next, and it has run that way ever since.
